posts.cooked:
Did you hear the crack of thunder that shook the very foundation of this forum? That was the sound of bots being sundered by the mighty banhammer.

Several IPs associated with the recent influx of spambot accounts have been banned from the forum, and we’re currently in the process of deleting those accounts. If you’re a real, live human who actually likes SotM and you’ve been affected by the IP bans, please send me an email directly, and I’ll see what I can do.

If you’re a bot, however, steel yourself for the reckoning!
